founders.name: Dmitri Zagidulin
founders.bio: Distributed systems engineer and authentication and credentials expert; Technical Architect for the DCC, contributing to core decentralization libraries, open standards, and conference organization.

founders.name: Omar Salah
founders.bio: Full-stack engineer specializing in web applications and backend systems; contributing to open-source projects in decentralized identity, digital wallets, verifiable credentials, and distributed storage.

founders.name: Kholoud Fattem
founders.bio: Full-stack and backend engineer with a strong foundation in software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems; contributes to open-source projects and builds interoperable, end-to-end solutions.

advisors.name: Juan “Bumblefudge” Caballero
advisors.bio: Juan Caballero works across every aspect of developer communities, from standardization and ecosystem-building to non-extractive sustainability models and community governance. Most of his work centers on open-sourcing and decentralizing digital identity and community data governance, with a particular fondness for groupware, information quality, and speech/communication networks. He can always find time for light-touch or time-bound community engagements and values-aligned grant-work.
